accuracy_definition: overall = micro top-1 accuracy over evaluation samples whose class has been introduced up to that experience; full = over all evaluation classes; old = over classes seen before the experience (null at experience 0); new = over classes introduced by the experience (null when none).
forgetting_definition: forgetting(c, t) = max{acc(c, t') : t' < t} - acc(c, t); the aggregate at experience t is the mean over every class that has a prior measurement. The first experience has no prior measurement (null / N-A). Negative values (a class improved on its previous best) are preserved.
